events.subtitle: Two-night special session in BODY&SOUL's final month
events.category: Contemporary Japanese jazz / all-star session / club farewell context
events.factual_description: BODY&SOUL presents Days of Delight All Stars 2026 on September 15 and 16, 2026, with the same schedule both nights: doors at 6:30 PM, first stage at 7:30 PM and second stage at 9:00 PM. The 2026 lineup is Miki Hirose on trumpet, Shigetaka Ikemoto on trombone, Jun Miyakawa on piano, Kunpei Nakabayashi on bass, Kazuhiro Odagiri on drums and Ryo Ogihara on guitar. Shigetaka Ikemoto's official schedule independently confirms both dates. The engagement takes place during BODY&SOUL's final month before its announced September 26 grand finale and closure. Days of Delight previously assembled an all-star group at the same club on December 10-11, 2025; those performances were recorded and released in 2026 as Live at BODY & SOUL and Live at BODY & SOUL vol.2, establishing a direct project-and-room continuity for the September 2026 return.

en.why_it_matters: Days of Delight has spent years treating contemporary Japanese jazz as something to document in the present tense, and BODY&SOUL became part of that archive when the label recorded its 2025 all-star sessions there. The September return is not a simple revival of that band: the 2026 configuration reshuffles the ensemble around Hirose, Ikemoto and Ogihara with Jun Miyakawa, Kunpei Nakabayashi and Kazuhiro Odagiri, putting a different current-scene rhythm section into the same room. Because BODY&SOUL closes ten days later, the two nights also become one of the last chances to hear this label's living-jazz idea inside a club that helped document it.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two nights if mid-September overlaps with Tokyo. The combination of a strong current Japanese lineup, Days of Delight's direct history in the room and BODY&SOUL's final month gives the engagement more weight than a routine club date, while the two-night format means it can fit around a truly singular farewell or one-off elsewhere in Kanto.

es.why_it_matters: Days of Delight lleva años tratando el jazz japonés contemporáneo como algo que hay que documentar en presente, y BODY&SOUL se volvió parte de ese archivo cuando el sello grabó ahí sus sesiones All Stars de 2025. El regreso de septiembre no es una simple repetición de aquella banda: la formación 2026 reorganiza el ensamble alrededor de Hirose, Ikemoto y Ogihara, ahora con Jun Miyakawa, Kunpei Nakabayashi y Kazuhiro Odagiri como otra sección rítmica de la escena actual. Como BODY&SOUL cierra diez días después, estas dos noches también quedan entre las últimas oportunidades de escuchar esa idea de jazz vivo del sello dentro de una sala que ayudó a documentarla.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las dos noches si septiembre coincide con Tokio. La mezcla de una alineación japonesa actual muy fuerte, la historia directa de Days of Delight en esa sala y el último mes de BODY&SOUL le da más peso que a una fecha rutinaria de club; al haber dos oportunidades, todavía puede acomodarse alrededor de una despedida o un one-off verdaderamente singular en otro punto de Kanto.
